description_en: Queries the raw event records reported by a specified device, including all events that passed or failed Thing Specification Language model validation
description_zh: 查询指定设备本身上报的原始事件（通过和未通过物模型校验的所有事件）记录
name: QueryDeviceOriginalEventData

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this ID value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数。数量限制：每页最多可显示50条。默认值是10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询设备所属的产品ProductKey。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name to query.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备名称。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page. If a next page exists, the service returns this token. Include this token in the next request
parameters.help_zh: 下一页标识。如果存在下一页，服务会返回此token，下次请求带上即可
parameters.name: next_page_token

parameters.help_en: The start time of the event records to query. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的事件记录的开始时间。格式为毫秒级的13位时间戳
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the event to query.

For weak validation, you can view the event Identifier of the device in the feature definition of the product to which the device belongs in the console. You can also call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html to view the identifier in the returned Thing Specification Language model information.
For no validation, the value must be the same as the custom identifier specified when the device reports the event
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的事件标识符。

对于弱校验，设备的事件Identifier，可在控制台中设备所属的产品的功能定义中查看；也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html，从返回的物模型信息中查看。
对于免校验，必须与设备事件上报时自定义的identifier一致
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order of event records in the response. Valid values:

0: in reverse chronological order.
1: in chronological order
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回结果中事件记录的排序方式，取值：

0：倒序。
1：正序
parameters.name: asc

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device to query. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device.

<notice> IotId is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。

<notice> IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The end time of the event records to query. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的事件记录的结束时间。格式为毫秒级的13位时间戳
parameters.name: end_time

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The device event records returned if the call was successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的设备事件记录

NextPageToken.description_en: The token for the next page

NextValid.description_en:
Indicates whether a next page of property records exists.

true: A next page exists.
false: No next page exists.

If NextValid is true, you can use the value of NextPageToken as the NextPageToken in the next request to query the remaining data
NextValid.description_zh:
是否有下一页属性记录。

true：有。
false：没有。

返回NextValid为true时，可以将NextPageToken的值作为下次查询的NextPageToken，继续查询本次查询不显示的数据

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
